transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Artificial intelligence is changing how lawyers work in the U.K. and Ireland, putting the billable hour under pressure and reshaping training and workloads, confirmed by CNBC.
The U.S. military nearly attacked a Chinese ship over a vessel misidentified by artificial intelligence as cargo in Iran, still open per South China Morning Post.
Shenzhen fined an artificial intelligence service for fabricating data to manipulate rankings, reported by 新浪财经, in a case involving unfair competition and regulatory penalties.
Agentic artificial intelligence exchange-traded funds launched in South Korea as investors eye an Anthropic initial public offering, reported by bloomingbit.
Microsoft released the Microsoft-Decision-1, a Qwen3.5-9B decision-scoring model, reported by MarkTechPost.
Free every hour.
